# What would close the monthly gap, and what each piece is worth

*Generated by `python3 -m pkinv.report.monthly_data_requests`. Every quantity here is
read from `outputs/pakemis_temporal_decomposition.csv` when this file is written, so a
request cannot go on claiming a gap that has been closed. Do not edit it by hand.*

The monthly product carries 4494.9 Mt of CO2e-AR5 across nine years. Of that, 21.6% is
mass that should vary within the year, is carried flat, and is asked for below.

## MON-OCAC-01 — Oil Companies Advisory Council (OCAC)

Extend the monthly petroleum sales panel back to the start of the inventory window so road and industrial combustion stop being carried on a flat line for six of nine years.

**Period.** July 2015 to June 2021  
**Fields.** month; customer class (Road, Total Industry, Railways, Aviation, Total Power); product (MS, HOBC, HSD, LDO, FO, JP-1, JP-8, KERO); quantity in metric tonnes  
**Boundary and definitions.** Monthly sales as published in the sectoral tables, either as direct monthly editions or as the cumulative columns this inventory differences; the fiscal year opens 1 July; product codes as printed rather than aggregated  
**Format.** PDF editions or CSV  
**Status.** drafted_not_sent  
**Where to ask.** OCAC statistics section. The editions from July 2021 onward are already held under sources/Aviation/ocac_monthly (48 PDFs, contiguous to June 2025). A REQUEST IS NECESSARY AND NOT MERELY UNDONE: OCAC's own archive index lists monthly editions from the current month back to July 2021 and stops, and before that date publishes fiscal-year compilations only (back to FY2016-17, held here as the annual controls). Verified 2026-09-30, logged in data/raw/ACQUISITION_LOG_ocac_monthly_pre2021.csv. No download closes this gap.

| component | unobserved | share of monthly mass | months already carried | driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| transport / Road transport | 285.86 Mt | 6.36% | 40.0% | OCAC customer-class monthly sales |
| industry / Industrial fuel combustion (1A2) | 143.41 Mt | 3.19% | 100.0% | OCAC monthly industrial liquids and utility gas deliveries |
| transport / Mixed off-road (1A4c/1A2) | 10.35 Mt | 0.23% | 40.0% | a claimant-specific profile: agricultural machinery follows the crop calendar and construction plant does not |
| railways / Railways | 2.58 Mt | 0.06% | 40.0% | OCAC railway diesel, monthly |
| aviation / Domestic aviation | 2.46 Mt | 0.06% | 40.0% | OCAC JP-1 monthly |

## MON-GAS-01 — OGRA with SNGPL and SSGC, and PPIS/DGPC for field-level detail

Give the gas network's seven fugitive segments and captive self-generation a monthly basis; every one of them is carried entirely flat today because supply is published annually and throughput monthly data is operational rather than published.

**Period.** July 2015 to June 2024  
**Fields.** month; system (SNGPL, SSGC); gas received at custody transfer; gas delivered by consumer category (domestic, commercial, industrial, power, fertiliser, cement, CNG, captive); unaccounted-for gas  
**Boundary and definitions.** MMCF at standard conditions; delivered volumes by the consumer categories the utilities already bill against, so that captive and grid power are separable; UFG as the utilities compute it, with the definition stated  
**Format.** CSV or XLSX  
**Status.** drafted_not_sent  
**Where to ask.** OGRA data cell; SNGPL and SSGC statistics departments. The annual State of the Regulated Petroleum Industry reports for all nine years are held under sources/OGRA and carry no monthly table

## MON-CPPAG-01 — CPPA-G and NEPRA

Close the RESIDUAL the public record cannot: monthly fuel quantities by plant where the published exhibits carry only energy, net-vs-gross definitions, NCV/heat-rate assumptions, and K-Electric own-generation outside the XWDISCO boundary. The plant-month GENERATION itself is no longer requested: NEPRA's SIR Detail-of-Generation listings carry it for FY2021-22 onward and are parsed into the plant-month panel at rc21 (scripts/ingest_sir_generation.py; the 4,644-document daily archive stays enumerated in data/catalog/manifests/power_sir_document_manifest.csv as the verification instrument) and the PBS panel covers the six years before.

**Period.** July 2020 to June 2024  
**Fields.** month; power station; fuel; net generation in kWh or GWh; fuel quantity consumed  
**Boundary and definitions.** Station-level rather than company-level, and fuel-level within a station, because a station's mix moves within the year and this inventory refuses to assume otherwise; CPPA-G, K-Electric and captive generation kept separate  
**Format.** CSV or XLSX  
**Status.** drafted_not_sent  
**Where to ask.** CPPA-G Market Operations; draft letter in docs/data_request_letters.md

| component | unobserved | share of monthly mass | months already carried | driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| power / Electricity and heat production | 146.83 Mt | 3.27% | 100.0% | plant-month generation by fuel |
